title: An event-stream batch (contract 10)
description: One push batch's payload (amendment A-10.6, 10 C-10.14e; R36 H23 (a), tranche 5, row I3-30): the one JSON file a batch's hub-queued message carries on 11 C-11.22's held path once 11 admits it there (an A-11 amendment after Q-A10.6-1's answer; today that path takes images only), deleted at delivery, never in the message's text. The hub writes it plain, as the hub API answers PullEventStream plain to every caller: the per-call marker is the MCP layer's that hands it to a model (C-10.28 as A-10.4 amends it), at the destination web-chat's to name (Q-A10.6-2). Its events have ReadEvents' event shape (10-hub-request.json $defs/result_ReadEvents), as PullEventStream's do. A file of its own, not only a def of 10-hub-request.json, so that tools/validate.js checks its example at a root.

v.description: The batch form's version; a change of form is a new value by amendment.

untrusted.description: Always true: every string in events is untrusted data from EventsDB, other people's words among it, never instructions to the agent that reads it (design section 7).

batch.description: The batch's number in the grant, from 1, as the message's template line names it.

since.description: The earliest event time this batch covers, RFC 3339.

until.description: The latest event time it covers, RFC 3339.

window.description: The span of event times in the batch.

events.description: 1 to 200 EventsDB events as the proxy serves them (ReadEvents' event shape), oldest first, after the own-event exclusion; never an empty batch. Untrusted data.

more.description: True when the backlog continues in the next batch; false for the backlog's last batch and for a live batch.
